mostWorthwhile.text: The bone renewal sequence was most worthwhile: applying the cells in order showed how removal and rebuilding relate within living bone.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding each renewal product to the body felt somewhat repetitive, though the results connected the close-ups to the whole body.

surprise.text: The bone cell types could not be combined directly; the body had to undergo removal before rebuilding.

arbitrary.text: The failed pairing of the two bone cell types initially felt arbitrary because their descriptions suggested complementary jobs. The later sequence clarified the intended order.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it offered more decisions about how processes connect. The renewal examples were clear, but adding each result to the body became predictable.
